How would y'all like to meet at the Lockerbie Pub? https://www.facebook.com/pages/The-Lockerbie-Pub/99082703138

 

I think it's got everything we're looking for:

1) It's near downtown -- Michigan St, just west of College Ave.

2) Free parking -- a small lot in back and street parking free after about 6pm

3) A variety of inexpensive food. 

4) Booths and tables of useful sizes

 

I talked to a bartender there yesterday and he said that Tuesday nights are usually pretty quiet -- they might have a few tables of people. He didn't seem put off by my mention of a group of 7-8 people playing a geeky card game. I didn't see any ashtrays or smell a lot of smoke. The bartender was taking a smoke break outside. There's a small bike rack in the back.

 

It's not perfect. There isn't a room tucked away from the rest of the pub. If there's an event going on, lots of people might crowd the place to watch the TV. Still, I think the main knock on the Mall/Arts Garden is that it seems sort of institutional, lacking in character. Plus the tables in the ArtsGarden are annoyingly small.

 

I can go either way. What do y'all think?
